capabilities: Annotate a selected word, sentence, or paragraph via a floating button or hotkey
Collect per-note annotations in a collapsible right sidebar with hover previews and click-to-scroll
Store annotations in per-note JSON files outside the note body
Re-attach annotations when notes are renamed or moved
Export an annotation digest as Markdown, WeChat-article HTML, or PDF
extras: Not yet in the community plugin store; currently installable via BRAT, manually, or once listed. Works only on Markdown notes; Reading view is the stable experience and marks may flicker in Live Preview.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach margin-style comments to selected passages without writing them into the note body.
summary: Margin-annotation tool that attaches comments to selected text, lists them in a right sidebar, and exports digests as Markdown, WeChat HTML, or PDF.
